products.description:
Overview: 

 
This desktop phone and tablet stand is made of aluminum alloy and ABS materials, ensuring durability and stability.
The foldable design makes it easy to carry and saves space when not in use.
The sleek and stylish silver appearance adds a touch of elegance to your desktop.
This stand is suitable for both phones and tablets, making it a versatile accessory for any device.
The 360-degree rotation allows for easy adjustment of the viewing angle to meet different needs. 
 

 
 
 

 
 Product Information: 
Type: desktop stand
 Color: black, white
 Material: Alloy
 Style: Universal
 Product Size: 100*70 * 162mm

 

 Packing List: 
 
1*Phone Bracket
